Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Replace DiagramService-as-content-writer with explicit revision operations, retention and generation orchestration. Preserve workspace/session/controller ownership; its organization still fits.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: MappingPage
  |   |   `-- Locate AgentChatPanel and agent access alongside the workspace; show CanvasHistory owning saved CanvasViews and generation metadata. Link these components to their lifecycle details.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D] Controller edits / agent access
  |   |   `-- Reorganize around buffered exec, optional immediate execution and supplied/generated revision batches converging on controller application. Preserve version checks, layout and history; the old per-call-only commit boundary is obsolete.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
  |   |   `-- Add canvasViews outside restored checkpoint state, retained review/presentation/context dependencies and current-only exports with revisionBoundary. These fit the history-owner model; expose CanvasHistory.startGeneration/updateGeneration as attachment points.
  |   `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
  |       `-- Replace sole-service ownership with immutable operations, explicit revision retention, generateDiagram orchestration and separate canvas publication. Preserve identity/correspondence; reference existing [G] Revision operations, retention, and generation detail rather than duplicate it.
  |
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Organize interfaces by unbound/bound MCP, native and refreshed chat_* tools, current reads, supplied versus prompt-driven edits and AgentChat/generation entry points. Preserve existing bridge, proposal and persistence interfaces; the former tool inventory and execution contract are obsolete.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
  |   |   `-- Locate AgentChatService, ChatDiagramTools, DiagramBatchService and GenerationCanvasBridge with their callers and owned state. Retain live/proposal routing; add shared CanvasApiProjection, context storage and checkpoint publication. Show PushIntegrationService -> DiffSessionWorkflowService -> ChangeSessionService/AgentDiagrammingSessionService only as supported backend connections.
  |   |-- [2] Add: Bound canvas reads and access
  |   |   `-- Explain captured turn targets/access, reused attachments, mismatch checks, identity reads, canvas.read small/full and read-scoped aliases. Attach from AgentDiagrammingSessionService.chatBindings and CanvasApiProjection; this develops the canvas API rather than conversation lifecycle.
  |   `-- [2] Add: Buffered exec and mutation receipts
  |       `-- Detail queued ID handles, read/preparation flush barriers, final flush and one controller transaction per flush. Show compact final-state receipts, immediate mode, discarded unflushed writes, surviving earlier commits and uncertain-outcome replay. Attach from AgentDiagrammingSessionService.exec; do not imply whole-script atomicity.
  |
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
  |   |   `-- Reorganize into context resolution, supplied-content or generator execution, retained outputs and single/batch installation. Locate DiagramBatchService owning child DiagramEditService runs and collecting one application; preserve preconditions and acknowledgement retries.
  |   |-- [4] Redraw: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
  |   |   `-- Separate single requests, batch envelopes and operation payloads: edit/create/extend, explicit edit/replace modes, scoped targets, pinned references, context sources and supplied candidates. The old single-target prompt model no longer explains the request boundaries.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
  |   |   `-- Add variants, creations, context output and DiagramBatchRun's indexed child results and retained application. Preserve the lifecycle; cancellation stops generation, while dispatched application requires acknowledgement rather than rollback.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
  |   |   `-- Add sourceRange-backed context and explicit source resolution, retaining immutable capture/hash validation. Connect to AgentContextLibrary and source adapters for storage and reads; the captured-context organization remains useful.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
  |   |   `-- Add operation/template inputs, pinned prompt references, replacement ranges and context handoff. Preserve history isolation and disposal; show supplied submissions bypassing the generator from the overview.
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
  |   |   `-- Add retained review candidates, optional presentation alternatives and creation results. Preserve immutable revision bindings; link to existing review/presentation detail instead of duplicating it.
  |   `-- [2] Add: AgentContext resolution and storage
  |       `-- Distinguish scoped in-memory uploads, durable AgentContextLibrary records and diagram-owned contexts checked by source fingerprint. Attach from AgentContextService.resolve and DiagramEditService's context-loading branch; this develops the canvas's established context subject.
  |
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Add FileChatStore, FileAgentContextRepository and FileDiagramAgentContextStore with their service callers. Show retained chat generation histories and request identities; these fit the existing storage-owner organization without duplicating chat lifecycle detail.
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Change whole-document save_diagram publication to persisted checkpoint publication and receipt acknowledgement; retain the separate single-diagram path and workspace-autosave/catalog-publication boundary.
  |
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
  |       `-- Update the separate whole-document save path to checkpoint -> publishCheckpoint -> saved acknowledgement. Preserve the browser owner-to-record-store flow; distinguish it from GenerationCanvasBridge's child-history persistence callback.
  |
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1a] Correct: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
  |       `-- Replace immediate-only exec behavior with default buffered batches and optional immediate mode. Preserve serialized ChangeSessionService.apply, controller guards, persisted receipts and proposal isolation; the lifecycle organization still fits.
  |
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
  |   `-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
  |       `-- Add managed generation from one saved parent endpoint, candidate view/chat identities, metadata and running-view guards. Finished results advance candidate endpoints without replacing the live head. Attach generation detail from CanvasHistory.startGeneration/updateGeneration; preserve branching and working-copy behavior.
  |
  |-- [3] AgentChat - turns, tools and persistence  new canvas
  |   |-- AgentChatService ownership and connections
  |   |   `-- Show AgentChatPanel -> AgentChatService -> CodexConnection, FileChatStore, ChatDiagramTools, MappingChatMcpBinding and GenerationCanvasBridge. A persistent conversation subsystem needs its own overview; connect from AgentChatService in the Mapping backend overview.
  |   |-- Chat turns, references and tool bindings
  |   |   `-- Detail create/import/resume, request persistence before turn/start, captured references, access settings and active-turn tool dispatch. Attach from AgentChatService.startTurn; link to Bound canvas reads and access rather than duplicate its API mechanics.
  |   |-- Tool registration and supplied diagram edits
  |   |   `-- Detail native definitions, explicit MCP reload and ChatDiagramTools reference/base/subtree validation before submitDirect. Attach from ChatDiagramTools and MappingChatMcpBinding; link to DiagramBatchService's shared-snapshot application flow.
  |   |-- Streaming, interaction and recovery
  |   |   `-- Detail buffered deltas, event reduction, approvals/questions, interruption, connection failure and restart handling. Attach from AgentChatService.receive and FileChatStore; distinguish persisted sessions from transient pending requests and bindings.
  |   `-- Managed generation entry
  |       `-- Locate AgentChatService.genAlternatives as owner of child chats and orchestration; connect that component to the managed-generation overview rather than repeat the lifecycle here.
  |
  `-- [3] Managed canvas generation - isolated candidates and publication  new canvas
      |-- Managed generation overview
      |   `-- Show AgentChatService coordinating saved CanvasViews, child chats and GenerationCanvasBridge-owned controllers. This cross-chat/canvas lifecycle needs its own overview; connect from AgentChatService.genAlternatives and Saved CanvasViews and branching.
      |-- Capture and launch
      |   `-- Detail deduplication, persisted candidate identities, one pinned saved checkpoint and parallel thread forks or saved-context thread starts. Attach from genAlternatives/launchGeneration; distinguish canvas input from conversation context, inherited model/tools and cleared inherited goals.
      |-- Isolated child canvas execution
      |   `-- Detail each GenerationCanvasBridge context's controller, serialized queue, receipts and history persistence callback. Attach from GenerationCanvasBridge.add/dispatch; show supported mutations and rejected fork management without duplicating buffered exec internals.
      |-- Settlement, cancellation and reconnect
      |   `-- Detail finishGeneration/cancelGeneration, parent interruption cascading to children, retained histories and finished-only endpoint publication. Attach from these AgentChatService components and CanvasHistory.updateGeneration; include pending-save reconciliation, stable-workspace reconnection and restart failure without automatic generation resumption.
      `-- Generation review and status
          `-- Show GenerateAlternatives, useGenerations and GenerationDetails exposing prompts, timing, usage, pending-save and input-waiting states. Attach from CanvasGeneration metadata and retained child chats; generated chats remain review-only and iteration starts another generation.
